Name: ZH's EBAGI - Vanilla Forage Crops
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fhgkAVA.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This EBAGI mod was made to be paired up with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods[/url] mod, adding EBAGI icons for all available artisan goods, which currently includes: Dried Mushrooms, Honey, Jelly, Juice, Pickles and Wine.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RLMQOV9.png[/img]﻿[/center][u]
[/u][b][u]ZH's EBAGI - Vanilla Forage Crops[/u][/b] 
Contains the items who's categories can be changed in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/url]. This will only work if those are enabled in the config. (Changing Daffodil and Dandelion into flowers, changing Leeks, Snow Yam, Spring Onion and Wild Horseradish into vegetables)

[u][b]ZH's EBAGI - Vanilla Forage Compat[/b] [/u]
This is made to [b]replace [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29533]ZH's EBAGI+[/url] file, due to the category changes above, to avoid any mix ups. Delete the ZH's EBAGI+ and then use both of these files.
 
These are made to be used together, so both can be downloaded and used.

[size=3][u][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/GqSTJrq.png[/img][/center][/u][/size]Until I figure out an easier way to change the styles around, this is currently how to change the styles. If a more experienced modder knows how I can do this, please feel free to let me know it would be a big help!

1. Inside the mod folder, there is both an Assets and All_Assets folder

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9JLbgZd.png[/img]
Assets is what will[i] [/i][u][i]appear in game[/i]
[/u]All_Assets has all available options to choose from.


2. You need to replace the .png files in Assets folder with the ones that you want. Go through the All_Assets folder to find the pattern and colour you want to use.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mXuCG7e.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿

3. [u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] Make sure that the .png files you replace in the Assets folder have the correct file name. If you change the names in any way, then it will not work. The correct names are shown in the image above this point.

There is a full image guide inside the mod folder that shows a visual guide on how to change your style. Please refer to that if needed.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pcnCZXd.png[/img][/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url].
3. Download the .zip file from this mod and install it

You're all done and ready to play.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pi5xeT0.png[/img]﻿
